name: Nakashima Jirou
source:
﻿A second-year student at K Middle School. He is [url=https://vndb.org/c93037]Satsuki's[/url] younger brother and [url=https://vndb.org/c93039]Kei's[/url] friend.

He is blunt and cocky, but he is concerned about his unreliable older sister and looks up to [url=https://vndb.org/c93027]Miriya[/url], who is very dependable. He attends the cram school at which [url=https://vndb.org/c93036]Kazumitsu[/url] works as a teacher.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_jiro.html]official website[/url]]
